I ran a paired t-test on new-book prices (`bookstore_new` vs `amazon_new`). Pairing fits because each textbook has a price from both sellers. Only 68 of the 201 rows have both prices, so the test uses those 68 pairs.

The test gives t = 2.20 with 67 degrees of freedom and a two-sided p-value of 0.0312. That is below 0.05, so the data reject the null hypothesis of no difference in average price.

I chose new-book prices over used ones, which the question doesn't specify.

ANSWER: 0.0312
